items.text_en: Work on the terraces while the stone is cool. Pruning, walling, planting, watering the young trees.
items.text_hr: Rad na terasama dok je kamen hladan. Rezidba, suhozid, sadnja, zalijevanje mladica.

items.text_en: Movement before the heat. Sun Moon Yoga, and the slow spinal work of Mana Movement in circles, spirals and waves.
items.text_hr: Pokret prije vrućine. Sun Moon Yoga i spori rad kralježnice po metodi Mana Movement, u krugovima, spiralama i valovima.

items.text_en: The sea. Total Immersion swimming, taught on site. Long body line, rotation around the spine, very little effort.
items.text_hr: More. Plivanje metodom Total Immersion, poučava se na terenu. Duga linija tijela, rotacija oko kralježnice, vrlo malo napora.

items.text_en: Back to work until the light goes. Processing, drying, distilling, the workshop.
items.text_hr: Natrag na posao dok ima svjetla. Prerada, sušenje, destilacija, radionica.

items.text_en: Music. Frame drum, percussion, and occasionally organic house. Dances of Universal Peace, the circle dances Samuel Lewis built in the 1960s from the sacred phrases of many traditions, which anyone can join without knowing a step.
items.text_hr: Glazba. Okvirni bubanj, perkusije, ponekad organic house. Dances of Universal Peace, kružni plesovi koje je Samuel Lewis šezdesetih složio od svetih fraza mnogih tradicija, a u koje se svatko može uključiti bez ijednog naučenog koraka.

items.text_en: Raw and living food, cold pressed juices, dried fruit. Figs, almonds, carob, olive oil, herbs and preserves as the land comes into production.
items.text_hr: Sirova i živa hrana, hladno tiješteni sokovi, sušeno voće. Smokve, bademi, rogač, maslinovo ulje, začinsko bilje i zimnica kako zemlja ulazi u proizvodnju.
